Definition: from G1722 and G5258; something seen in sleep, i.e. a dream (vision in a dream):--dream.
BiblicalUsage: A dream — something seen in sleep. Peter promises on Pentecost that old men shall dream dreams in Acts 2:17, when God pours out His Spirit on all flesh.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God still speaks in dreams when He chooses, and the promise of Pentecost is that His Spirit falls on the old as well as the young.
